game.name: Torus Trooper
game.desc: A high-speed arcade shooter by Kenta Cho (ABA Games). Fly down a twisting torus, destroy enemies and dodge BulletML barrages against a countdown timer. A held charge shot pierces enemies, wipes out bullets and works as a regenerative brake; bosses and score targets add time. Three grades (Normal, Hard, Extreme), a selectable starting level and a replay of your last game.
